in_marathi.name: Chitrarath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Painter of pictures in the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrarath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chitra means 'picture' or 'painting' and Rath means 'chariot' or 'vehicle'. Chitrarath is the one who paints pictures on the sky with his chariot. This name is derived from Hindu mythology, specifically from the god Indra who is often depicted riding a chariot drawn by horses.
